theorems.name: Submission.gwe_graph_jacobian_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (D : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (D (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (D (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ))))) ∧ (‖D‖ ≤ 1 → Real.sqrt (Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (D (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (D (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ))))) ≤ 1 + Real.exp ((n : ℝ) / 2) / 2 * hsNormSq D)
